preRegistration.text:
# Pre-registration: KELT-23 A b, MObs 2026-09-05 (committed before any frame was examined)

Frames: 84, 04:16:18 to 09:05:56 UT (JD 2461288.678 to .879).
Ephemeris (archive, as in inits_kelt23a_aug.json): T0 2458918.461247, P 2.25528745 -> epoch 1051, Tmid 2461288.7684 (06:26:26 UT).
Anchored on my 08-09 epoch (2461261.7062): 2461288.7696 (06:28:18 UT), 1.9 min later.
T14 ~2.2 h: ingress ~05:20, egress ~07:33. Coverage: full transit, ~1 h pre, ~1.5 h post.

Predictions:
- QC PASS expected if the night is clear (full transit, bright target V~10.3, comps 0.7-1.0x available).
- Tmid within +/-3 min of 2461288.7684. The two anchors differ by 1.9 min; an honest bar on a 0.7%-scatter MObs full transit is ~1.5-2 min, so this epoch CANNOT distinguish them and will not be claimed to.
- Any printed bar under 0.001 d is a replaced bar (#1401) and gets refit before entering the ledger.
- Seed trap: 08-09's first two frames saturated the target. Check the first frames before seeding; exclude saturated ones.

## Outcome (appended 2026-09-05 evening, after the reduction)
- QC: MARGINAL 3.94/5.00 (predicted PASS). Missed on residual flatness into dawn.
- Tmid 2461288.7696 +/- 0.0046 (+1.7 min from 2461288.7684): inside the +/-3 min band. Anchors not distinguished, as stated.
- Bar: 6.6 min against a predicted 1.5-2 min. Missed by ~3x. See the WASP-11 outcome for the pattern.
- Replaced-bar check: clean. Seed trap: avoided (frame 1 solved; check_inits caught a mid-night seed at +10 ADU).

parameters.Fit parameter point estimate: Best-fit likelihood point; uncertainties are posterior spread.
parameters.Pre-UltraNest LM boundary scout note: LM solution and covariance envelope were interior after 4 iteration(s).
parameters.Out-of-transit baseline parameter-fit no: Used a0 and a2 from the previous fast UltraNest fit for the full-resolution final run.
parameters.Out-of-transit baseline detrending note: only 20 pre-ingress and 10 post-egress out-of-transit point(s) were available; need more than 12 on each side to fit a linear baseline.
parameters.Sparse posterior live-point extension no: Applied full-resolution selected comparison-star final UltraNest run (200->1200 minimum live points) with fixed a0/a2 from the previous fast UltraNest fit.
parameters.Final residual rejection note: No residual outliers exceeded 3.0 sigma from the iterated median residual (0.0676%, stdev=0.8609%).
parameters.Uncertainty interpretation note: The primary Rp/R* and radius-ratio area-depth uncertainties use model+red-noise when available. The red-noise uncertainty inflates the data-fit standard error by a residual time-binning beta factor before combining it with the model posterior. The flux baseline red-noise uncertainty is the out-of-transit baseline component used for the final-plot baseline band; the transit-depth red-noise uncertainty already includes both the in-transit and baseline terms. The same residual time-binning beta factor is applied to the posterior uncertainties for Tmid, a/Rs, inclination, and impact parameter when reporting their primary model+red-noise uncertainties. The flux-scatter equivalent is also shown as a diagnostic of the full residual scatter around the model.
